knowledge:
- key_parameters: TF=The transcription factor probe or gene identifier used as the driving input ;; targets=The target gene probe or gene identifier(s) to fit in the model ;; testTargets=Candidate target genes to be ranked by GPRankTargets ;; knownTargets=Known target genes used to fit a joint model when ranking other candidate targets ;; filterLimit=Z-score threshold used to filter out weakly expressed genes during ranking ;; experiments=Vector specifying independent time series replicates ;; scoreSaveFile=File path to save intermediate scores during batch/parallel ranking
- alternatives: puma::mmgmos=Recommended for preprocessing Affymetrix array data to extract error bars (measurement uncertainties) which are directly utilized by tigre models
- when_to_use: When analyzing gene expression time series data from single input motif networks to infer latent transcription factor protein concentrations or rank potential TF target genes
- pitfalls: Using non-Affymetrix data (or data without uncertainty information) requires estimating noise variances together with other model parameters, and weakly expressed genes cannot be easily filtered a priori ;; Filtering non-Affymetrix data based on log-likelihood differences requires careful, dataset-specific threshold selection and visualization to avoid mistakes ;; GPRankTargets does not return the models by default to save space; they must be recreated using generateModels

workflows.name: affymetrix_time_series_analysis
workflows.intent: Analyze Affymetrix time series data to learn GP models, rank targets, and export results.
workflows.stages: 1. Load and preprocess CEL files using ReadAffy and mmgmos ;; 2. Format data for GP modeling using processData ;; 3. Learn single-target, joint multi-target, or translation-free models using GPLearn ;; 4. Plot models using GPPlot ;; 5. Rank candidate targets using GPRankTargets ;; 6. Recreate top models using generateModels ;; 7. Export scores and models to an SQLite database using export.scores
workflows.code:
expfiles <- c(paste("embryo_tc_4_", 1:12, ".CEL", sep=""),
              paste("embryo_tc_6_", 1:12, ".CEL", sep=""),
              paste("embryo_tc_8_", 1:12, ".CEL", sep=""))
expdata <- ReadAffy(filenames=expfiles,
                    celfile.path="embryo_tc_array_data")
pData(expdata) <- data.frame("time.h" = rep(1:12, 3),
                             row.names=rownames(pData(expdata)))
drosophila_mmgmos_exprs <- mmgmos(expdata)
drosophila_mmgmos_fragment <- drosophila_mmgmos_exprs
drosophila_gpsim_fragment <-
  processData(drosophila_mmgmos_fragment,
              experiments=rep(1:3, each=12))
data(drosophila_gpsim_fragment)
targets <- c('FBgn0003486', 'FBgn0033188', 'FBgn0035257')
library(annotate)
aliasMapping <- getAnnMap("ALIAS2PROBE",
                  annotation(drosophila_gpsim_fragment))
twi <- get('twi', env=aliasMapping)
fbgnMapping <- getAnnMap("FLYBASE2PROBE",
                 annotation(drosophila_gpsim_fragment))
targetProbes <- mget(targets, env=fbgnMapping)
st_models <- list()
for (i in seq(along=targetProbes)) {
  st_models[[i]] <- GPLearn(drosophila_gpsim_fragment,
                            TF=twi, targets=targetProbes[i],
                            quiet=TRUE)
}
mt_model <- GPLearn(drosophila_gpsim_fragment, TF=twi,
                    targets=targetProbes,
                    quiet=TRUE)
show(mt_model)
nt_model <- GPLearn(drosophila_gpsim_fragment,
                    targets=c(twi, targetProbes[1:2]), quiet=TRUE)
GPPlot(st_models[[1]], nameMapping=getAnnMap("FLYBASE",
                         annotation(drosophila_gpsim_fragment)))
scores <- GPRankTargets(drosophila_gpsim_fragment, TF=twi,
                        testTargets=targetProbes,
                        options=list(quiet=TRUE),
                        filterLimit=1.8)
scores <- sort(scores, decreasing=TRUE)
write.scores(scores)
topmodel <- generateModels(drosophila_gpsim_fragment,
                           scores[1])
show(topmodel)
scores <- GPRankTargets(drosophila_gpsim_fragment, TF=twi,
                        knownTargets=targetProbes[1],
                        testTargets=targetProbes[2:3],
                        options=list(quiet=TRUE),
                        filterLimit=1.8)
scores <- sort(scores, decreasing=TRUE)
write.scores(scores)
export.scores(scores, datasetName='Drosophila',
              experimentSet='GPSIM/GPDISIM',
              database='database.sqlite',
              preprocData=drosophila_gpsim_fragment,
              models=models,
              aliasTypes=c('SYMBOL', 'GENENAME', 'FLYBASE', 'ENTREZID'))

workflows.intent: Preprocess non-Affymetrix expression data or data without associated uncertainty information.
